questions.stem: When can the customer collect the items?
options: C. Any time after 4 P.M. on Monday
questions.explanation: The receipt says "Ready for pickup: Thurs., Nov. 7, after 4 P.M."

questions.stem: What is indicated about the customer?
options: A. The customer has already paid.
B. The customer will donate the coat.
D. The customer dropped off three coats.
questions.explanation: The total is marked "$25.00 (paid)," so nothing more is owed at pickup.
